rules.explanation: NBA game footage may be published in FR and US on Instagram and YouTube, for editorial, organic or sponsored posts, until 31 Dec 2026.
Players, officials and arena signage that appear in NBA game footage are cleared for club social use.
Sponsored campaign posts must not show a rival sponsor's branding (exclusivity clause). A reviewer flags rival branding with the label brand:rival-sponsor.
NBA game footage is geo-blocked in GB because a broadcaster holds an exclusive window there.
Sponsored NBA footage may not be posted on TikTok.
